rules.title: Retinoid ingredient and pregnancy
rules.explanation: Regulators advise against using topical retinoids during pregnancy as a precaution, even though very little is absorbed through skin. If you are pregnant or planning to be, check this product with your doctor or pharmacist.

source.label: EMA: updated measures for pregnancy prevention during retinoid use
